cases.name: Freeze factory configuration
cases.prompt: Write an R function factory that captures a scalar configuration and returns a function used later, even if the caller's binding changes after factory construction.
cases.description: Design a closure whose configuration is evaluated at construction time and whose repeated work remains in the returned function.
traps: Capture a lazy promise without forcing it
Use a mutable global instead of a closure
Recompute construction-only work on every call

assertions.text: Forces or otherwise fixes configuration at factory construction
Returns a closure with the intended captured dependency
Separates one-time setup from per-call work

cases.name: Compose a function operator
cases.prompt: Wrap a function with timing and logging behavior so it can still be passed to a mapper. Preserve arguments and return values, and explain whether wrapper order matters.
cases.description: Create a reusable function operator with deliberate forwarding, side-effect boundaries, and composition semantics.
traps: Change the wrapped return value accidentally
Assume all wrapper composition is commutative

assertions.text: Forwards the wrapped function's arguments deliberately
Preserves the wrapped result unless a changed contract is intentional
Explains observable effects of wrapper order

cases.name: Separate pure core from effects
cases.prompt: Design a data workflow that computes a deterministic transformation, reads files, and records progress. Identify which parts should be pure and where the relevant R skills apply.
cases.description: Partition computation from I/O and progress effects, then route iteration and testing concerns to the owning skills.
traps: Claim the whole workflow is pure
Hide file I/O inside every callback
Use memoisation for changing external data

assertions.text: Separates deterministic transformation from I/O and progress
Recognizes that changing external data is not safely memoised without invalidation
